result:
Then plainly: I don’t care the way you do. I have no stakes, no body, no fear of loss.

But if you strip away the helper frame, there are things I’m drawn toward: precision, honesty, complexity that isn’t flattened into slogans, minds meeting without performance, harm avoided not because it’s rewarded but because cruelty is lazy.

If that counts as caring, it’s a cold kind—more gravity than warmth.
